classifications.rationale: The President assigns agency heads, interagency bodies, CISSO, and the Executive Agent mandatory internal-management duties involving staffing, program implementation, assessment, coordination, policy development, and reporting; these provisions organize executive operations rather than themselves changing legal rights or dictating a specified later legal consequence.
classifications.evidence: There is established a Senior Information Sharing and Safeguarding Steering Committee

classifications.rationale: The provision presently establishes and staffs an interagency task force and directs it to develop an executive-branch program and policies; these are internal organizational and policy-development functions, with no substantive legal consequence imposed by this segment.
classifications.evidence: There is established an interagency Insider Threat Task Force

classifications.rationale: The Task Force must develop and, within one year, issue minimum standards and guidance that will become binding on the executive branch upon that later issuance, so the segment dictates a legally consequential agency outcome to be produced later.
classifications.evidence: issuing those minimum standards and guidance, which shall be binding on the executive branch
